DailyAI

As a fun way to be maliciously compliant, I automated my participation in my company's standup meetings. Using playwright to scrape the state of my activities out of our custom kanban board and GitLab's api to get specific data about my activities. I set an automation flow where I feed said data to a llm and process the resulting report through a text to speech tool in order to play the generated audio during the meetings through a virtual microphone

Technologies Used

  • Playwright
  • GitLab API
  • OpenAI API
Distributed Greenhouse Monitoring System
Worked on the backend of a scalable multi-sensor data platform with real-time alerts and microservices architecture for greenhouse environment monitoring.
×

Distributed Greenhouse Monitoring System

This project was developed for my distributed systems class and focused on designing a robust backend architecture to unify heterogeneous sensor data from multiple greenhouses. Sensors from different brands sent temperature and humidity readings in various formats (Fahrenheit, Celsius, JSON, XML). I built a middleware service that authenticates senders, standardizes data into a unified format, checks threshold violations, triggers alert notifications via SMS, and persists data to MongoDB. The system includes microservices for sensor management, alarms (using Twilio), reporting, and a REST API for third-party analytics access. The middleware communicates asynchronously with microservices through RabbitMQ and interacts with the frontend via HTTP requests. Configuration data is stored in MySQL for relational consistency. Additionally, I developed a greenhouse simulator on an ESP32 device that connects to the middleware through WebSockets to mimic real sensor data. The backend services are primarily written with Nest.js and TypeScript, the alarm microservice with Python Flask, and the simulation in Arduino C++.

Technologies Used

  • Nest.js
  • Typescript
  • Python
  • Flask
  • RabbitMQ
  • MongoDB
  • MySQL
  • ESP32 & C++
  • Twilio API
  • Web Sockets

Academic Information Center (CIA)

×

Academic Information Center (CIA)

Developed as a team project for a web development class, CIA is a modernized clone of our university’s enrollment system. It provides two main interfaces: an administrator panel to configure courses and curricula, and a student portal for enrollment. The system enforces curricular planning rules by allowing students to enroll only in classes for which they have met prerequisites. It also checks for schedule conflicts to ensure a smooth registration process. The project used microfrontends for modular development and JWTs for secure authentication. Built with pure JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, CIA emphasizes simplicity and usability while handling complex enrollment logic.

Technologies Used

  • JavaScript
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • JWT
  • Microfrontends

3D Engine
A custom-built 3D engine developed from scratch in Java, with real-time rendering, transformations, and basic model manipulation.
×

3D Engine

This project is a basic 3D engine developed using Java and linear algebra concepts. It allows for hardcoded 3D models to be defined, rendered, rotated, and colored in a 3D space. I implemented the engine from scratch as a way to explore applied linear algebra and foundational graphics programming. The renderer handles perspective projection, rotation matrices, and real-time updates through a basic UI. This project helped me build an intuitive understanding of 3D transformations and low-level rendering logic.

Technologies Used

  • Java
  • Lineal Algebra

Photography Studio Manager

This project involved developing the backend of a web application tailored for photography studios to efficiently manage their business information and appointment schedules. A key feature is the integration with a WhatsApp bot, allowing customers to easily inquire about available packages, book services, and schedule appointments through conversational messaging. The backend was implemented using Nest.js with TypeScript and MySQL for reliable data management. Although this project does not include AI components, it demonstrates strong full-stack backend development and API integration skills.

  • Nest.js
  • Typescript
  • MySQL
  • BuilderBot
